item.title: Week 10: Patriots at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 9:30 AM ET | Line: DET -2.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model DET 54% vs. market 57% | On paper this one is close: Detroit's best edge is to wrap up (Detroit's defense ranks 1st in broken tackles per touch, 8.3% missed), while New England's best counter is to win through the air (New England ranks 7th in EPA per dropback, +0.18). Under center, Drake Maye ranks 9th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Jared Goff ranks 11th; x-factor: Amon-Ra St. Brown gets 33% of Detroit's targets and 36% of its air yards, and His WOPR (0.75) ranks 6th of 1211. New England's pass defense ranks 21st. The model favors Detroit at 54%, mostly on rushing matchup (1.2 pts) and offensive injuries (0.3 pts).
